candidates.name: Erdheim-Chester disease
support_spans: bilateral symmetric sclerotic changes of the distal femora and proximal tibiae
multifocal intramedullary sclerosis of the femora and tibiae
diffuse infiltration by foamy histiocytes and fibrosis with rare Touton-like giant cells
Immunohistochemical staining of the histiocytes was positive for CD68, CD163, and factor XIIIa
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of diffuse bone pain, bilateral exophthalmos, and radiographic findings of symmetric sclerotic changes in long bones, along with the histopathological features of foamy histiocytes and Touton-like giant cells, are characteristic of Erdheim-Chester disease.
